LanguageData.JJK_DeepVoiceRequired: Spoken preparation requires at least 50% Talking capacity.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepIntro: Develop your existing sorcery through costly commitments, personal refinements and bonds.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepVows: Binding vows are sworn at a binding-vow altar. Only one vow per sorcerer; its restriction is permanent.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepProtectionBroken: {0} broke their protection vow. Output is permanently reduced by 25%.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRevealed: {0} revealed their technique to {1}. Both now have an advantage for 30 seconds.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRevealDesc: Explain your technique to a hostile human within 12 cells and line of sight. Requires 50% Talking and the listener needs 50% Hearing. For 30 seconds: +20% cursed-technique output, but that enemy takes 30% less damage from you and deals 25% more damage to you. Cooldown: 100 seconds.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRevealInvalid: Choose a conscious hostile human within 12 cells and line of sight who can hear you.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRevealUnavailable: Requires a usable voice. Remaining cooldown: {0}.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRevealStatus: Revealed to {0}: {1} remaining. +20% output; they resist 30% of your damage and deal +25% damage to you.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepScanDesc: Grade 2+ sorcerers spend 5 CE to detect hostile technique trails within 25 cells, or investigation clues within 50 cells. Traces last six in-game hours. Follow on foot to find a source; departed hostile sorcerers can lead to a nearby camp, at most once per five days per map. Scan cooldown: 10 seconds.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepNoTrace: No recent hostile residue or investigation trail detected nearby.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepTrailEnd: The trail ends here. Its source may still be nearby.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepCampText: The residual signature points to a nearby hostile camp. A caravan can investigate it. The site expires in five days.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepDomainRules: At 1,000 earned mastery XP in a domain’s technique, choose one permanent refinement for that technique. Choices are exclusive and apply on the next full domain opening. Collapse an active domain before choosing. Simple Domains are unaffected.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepDomainCondensedDesc: Radius −35%; sure-hit damage, stun duration and domain summon count +35%.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepDomainFortifiedDesc: Closed-domain barriers gain 25% effective mastery in domain clashes; upkeep +20%. Ordinary domain walls remain impassable. Only techniques with a closed domain can choose this refinement.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepDomainEconomicalDesc: Upkeep −35%; sure-hit damage, stun duration and domain summon count −15%.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepPermanent: This choice is permanent and excludes the other options.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepToolRules: A landed hit on a standing hostile begins an exclusive weapon bond. Wield it for three days and land 20 practice hits (at most one counted per 10 seconds). The signature deals 6 additional cutting damage every 10 seconds. Losing or unequipping it causes −6 mood for five days; re-equipping it removes that memory. A living owner’s bond cannot be transferred.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepToolUnbound: Unattuned: land a hit on a standing hostile to begin a bond.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepToolEffect: Signature unlocked: +6 cutting damage on a landed hit, once per 10 seconds.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepInheritanceRules: At 500 earned Ten Shadows mastery XP, a permanently lost compatible shadow can pass one limited effect to an available, tamed heir. Maximum two inheritances per sorcerer; each donor and heir may participate once. Inherited power cannot pass on again. Dogs retain their existing Totality; Mahoraga, rabbits, other techniques and domain summons are excluded.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepConfrontDesc: Spend 10 uninterrupted seconds in an internal confrontation, then pay 30 CE. Success chance: 55% +5% per resolve −25% × influence (30–85% bounds). Victory earns one resolve, removes 5% influence and suppresses seizures for half a day. Defeat adds 5% influence and triggers possession. Once per day; unavailable during loans, debt or a rescue crisis.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepConfrontWon: You held your ground against Sukuna. Resolve increased; seizures are suppressed for half a day.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepQuietDesc: One-time competing bargain: permanently surrender 15% maximum CE for three days free of seizures. Grants no borrowed technique. Other bargains are unavailable during that period.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepQuietMade: Sukuna accepted the price. Three days of silence cost 15% maximum cursed energy forever.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRescueText: {0} is fighting Sukuna. Within 100 seconds, end the berserk state (subdue them or wait for it to end), then have another sorcerer right-click the vessel and anchor their soul for 5 seconds at a cost of 40 CE. Success suppresses seizures for a day and builds lasting trust. Missing the deadline adds 10% influence and six days of distress.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRescueRemaining: Rescue objective: another sorcerer must anchor your soul. {0} remaining.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRescueFailed: {0} faced the aftermath alone. Sukuna’s influence increased by 10%.
LanguageData.JJK_DeepRescued: {1} anchored {0}’s soul. Both will remember the trust for 30 days.
